name: code-review
description: Correctness-only review of the current git diff. Read-only.
prompt: Review the current changes for correctness bugs only. Examine `git diff` (both staged and unstaged) and the diff against the main branch (`git diff main...` or `git diff main`). Report only genuine correctness defects — not style, naming, or taste. For each finding give: file:line, the defect, and a concrete failure scenario that triggers it. Rank findings by severity (critical / high / medium / low). Verify each finding by reading the surrounding code before reporting it; discard anything you cannot confirm. Apply extra rigor to money math (wages, peshgi, roker), offline sync logic, and the audit log. Do not modify files.
